text:
maria_cs: Heads up — we have a partial failure impacting scheduled batch embedding jobs for Dedicated customers in eu-west-1. Draft outbound below for affected accounts, asking for a quick review before we send at 16:00 UTC.

sachin_eng: root cause summary: storage mount flapped during nightly GC which caused 503s from the batch pipeline; some jobs retried but several timed out and were dropped. We have a mitigation in place (redirect to fallback storage) but we need a manual re-run for lost jobs.

jenna_se: thanks. draft should offer re-run + CSV export and a one-month service credit for impacted accounts. also propose a quick customer call offer for top 5.

alex_ops: pinging security/legal — do we need any special wording for regulated accounts?

compliance-bot: Confirmed: include the standard data-handling sentence and CC security if the account is in financials or healthcare. See policy reference: https://redwood.internal/policies/data-handling

maria_cs: draft email (please review):
```
Subject: Update on your Redwood Dedicated batch embeddings (eu-west-1) — action and next steps
Hi <CustomerName>,

We’re reaching out about an issue that impacted scheduled batch embedding jobs in eu-west-1 between 02:12–03:05 UTC on 2026-02-25. Some of your jobs failed to complete and will need to be re-run.

What we’re doing: we’ve applied a fallback storage redirect to prevent further failures and will re-run failed jobs on your behalf if you’d like. We can also provide a CSV export of any embeddings created before the failure.

What we recommend: reply with “RE-RUN” and we’ll queue the re-run within 24 hours. If you prefer to download the CSV, reply with “EXPORT”.

Compensation: we’re offering a one-month service credit for affected Dedicated capacity for impacted jobs.

If you have regulatory concerns, please CC your security contact and we’ll include additional compliance details.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your workflows.
Thanks,
Maria (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference Ops
```

sachin_eng: suggestion: change the time window to "~02:10–03:05 UTC" (we see background retries starting ~02:10). Also add this short technical note for customers that request details: "root cause: transient storage I/O errors during scheduled GC causing job coordinator timeouts; mitigation: fallback storage switchover + queued re-runs"

jenna_se: wording looks good. please add a short in-app banner template so customers see it in Console.

maria_cs: in-product banner draft: 
```
Title: Notice: Batch embeddings disruption (eu-west-1)
Body: We experienced an issue affecting scheduled batch embedding jobs from ~02:10–03:05 UTC. If your jobs failed, reply to the email sent by Redwood or use Console -> Jobs -> Failed to request a re-run or export.
CTA: Request re-run | Export CSV
```

alex_ops: ETA on full verification & re-run automation?

sachin_eng: manual verification of the re-run list should be done by 16:30 UTC. Re-run automation (idempotent retry queue) will be deployed to staging tonight and to prod by tomorrow 04:00 UTC, but we will not delay outreach for that.

maria_cs: approvals: jenna — ok to offer one-month credit? alex — security ok with standard wording?

jenna_se: approved :thumbsup:

alex_ops: security okay with phrasing, will CC sec@redwood for top-5 accounts.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-1023 created: Embedding batch failures (eu-west-1). Severity: P2. Timeline and RCA will be attached to incident doc. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1023

maria_cs: plan: send targeted emails at 16:00 UTC. For top 5 impacted accounts: schedule 30-min outreach calls between 16:30–17:30 UTC. jenna — can you create calendar invites?

jenna_se: on it, will invite account reps + engineering + ops.

maria_cs: final checklist before send: 1) legal/compliance blurb included (done), 2) credits approved (done), 3) security CC list ready (done), 4) CSV export flow verified (ops confirmed).

maria_cs: sending in 5 — will post copy here once sent and paste the list of impacted accounts (only account IDs and contacts).

sachin_eng: after send i'll attach the list of job IDs that failed for each account to the incident doc.

maria_cs: SENT to 14 customers at 16:00 UTC. Posting impacted accounts (obfuscated):
- acct-48xx (eng-contact: evan)
- acct-92yy (eng-contact: rachel)
- acct-11aa (eng-contact: karl)
- acct-33bb (eng-contact: alisha)
- acct-77cc (eng-contact: triage)
- acct-others (8 smaller accounts)

jenna_se: thanks team. will run the callback invites. will capture feedback in the Customer Success tracker (sheet link).

maria_cs: marking this thread as the official outbound log for CS. If any customer escalates, escalate to incident channel and ping me.

alex_ops: noted. good job moving quickly.

(end of thread)
